title: Proof of Identity
description: Documents that verify the identity of the customer, such as a passport, driver’s license, or national ID card.

document_types.title: Passport
document_types.description: A government-issued document that certifies the identity and nationality of the holder for international travel.

document_types.title: Driver's License
document_types.description: An official document permitting a specific individual to operate one or more types of motorized vehicles.

title: Proof of Address
description: Documents that confirm the customer’s residential address, such as utility bills, bank statements, or rental agreements.

document_types.title: Driver's License
document_types.description: An official document permitting a specific individual to operate one or more types of motorized vehicles.

document_types.title: Bank Account Statement
document_types.description: A document issued by a bank detailing the account holder’s transactions and balance over a specific period.

document_types.title: Utility Bill
document_types.description: A document issued by a utility service provider that confirms the customer’s residential address.

document_types.title: Council Tax Bill
document_types.description: A document issued by the local council in the UK, used as proof of residence and address verification.

title: Source of Funds
description: Documents that provide evidence of the source of the customer’s funds, such as payslips, bank statements, or tax returns.

document_types.title: Bank Account Statement
document_types.description: A document issued by a bank detailing the account holder’s transactions and balance over a specific period.

document_types.title: Salary Slip
document_types.description: A document provided by an employer that outlines an employee’s earnings, deductions, and net pay for a specific period.

document_types.title: Loan Agreement
document_types.description: A formal agreement between a borrower and a lender outlining the terms and conditions of a loan, including repayment schedules, interest rates, and other relevant details.

document_types.title: Re-Mortgage Statement
document_types.description: A statement detailing the financial transactions and balances associated with a re-mortgage, typically provided by the lender or financial institution managing the mortgage.

document_types.title: Savings Account Statement
document_types.description: A document provided by a financial institution that details the transactions, deposits, withdrawals, and current balance of a customer's savings account.
